responsibility: Declares the public backend interfaces for MinGW/Windows PE/COFF import-symbol handling implemented in winnt-dll.cc. It exposes helpers for testing whether an RTL symbol is imported, obtaining the MinGW GOT/refptr alias set, and legitimizing PE/COFF symbol addresses through dllimport or refptr indirection, so target backend code can share this import-lowering logic.
same_name_distinction: This is the header half of the winnt-dll pair: it exposes the public declarations for imported-symbol tests, GOT alias-set access, and PE/COFF symbol legitimization, while `winnt-dll.cc` provides the actual implementation of the synthetic `__imp_`/`refptr` creation and address-rewriting logic.
